title: Suggestions Wire (Vault-published editor surface)
description: Complete, structured mirror of the review surface, published to the vault every Pass 1 (ADR-026). The Hashi Suggestions Editor reads and edits it; Tomo owns it. emit_digest is the tool-agnostic change signal: when it no longer matches a recomputation over the editable payload, Pass-2 rebuilds its ENTIRE output from this JSON alone (build_from_wire) — never re-reading the markdown. So every editable decision the markdown offers is carried here.

emit_digest.description: SHA-256 over the canonical editable payload (this object with emit_digest absent). Recomputed and compared in Pass 2 to detect edits.

suggestions.description: One entry per atomic note suggestion, keyed by its stable S## id. Carries the full editable per-note surface.

title.description: Editable — the note name; the filename derives from it.

audio_peer.description: Read-only — audio peer basename, when the source is an audio+transcript pair.

decision.description: Editable — create the note (approve) or not (skip). Default mirrors the Approve pre-check (approve when worthiness >= 0.5).

keep_source.description: Editable — when approved, keep the origin inbox note instead of deleting it. Default false (origin is consumed).

delete_source.description: Editable — explicitly delete the origin. Default false.

force_atomic.description: Editable — promote a suppressed (sub-worthy) atomic. Default from the light-block opt-in.

suppressed.description: Read-only render hint — Tomo kept this in the inbox as a light block; force_atomic promotes it.

candidate_mocs.description: Candidate MOCs. selected mirrors the pre-checked state; the editor toggles it and may add entries with source='user'.

path.description: Vault-relative MOC path (the stable key for an existing MOC).

source.description: tomo = Tomo-proposed; user = added in the editor. Pass-2 honours both identically.

anchor.description: Resolved placement anchor (spec 022/023 shape). Null when none was resolved. `inside` never appears on a heading/line anchor (executor constraint).

proposed_mocs.description: Proposed new MOCs, keyed by a stable M## id so the editor can merge/rename them as a graph op. member_ids link notes by their S## id.

decision.description: Editable — create the MOC (approve) or not (skip). Default skip.

daily_updates.description: Daily-note updates (ADR-026 full mirror), carried in the parser's own output shape. Under JSON-only, build_from_wire passes these through verbatim and instruction-render reads content/position/time straight from each entry — so edits flow to the rendered daily note. Own-the-whole-document: preserve every field and sibling entry you don't edit.

time.description: Editable — HH:MM, only meaningful when position == at_time; null otherwise.

position.description: Editable — placement in the daily log.

force_atomic_note.description: Editable — kept in sync per source-stem with suggestions[].force_atomic.

target_stem.description: Read-only — the atomic note the log links to.

tag_handler_groups.description: Tag-handler group approvals (ADR-026 full mirror). Preserve-only in v1.

keep_source.description: Editable — leave the captured inbox notes in place.

handler.description: Read-only display — the tag-handler that claimed the items.

target_path.description: Read-only display — the note the capture is written to.

marker.description: Read-only display — the anchor/marker in the target note.

source_paths.description: Read-only display — the inbox notes captured into this group.

preview.description: Read-only display — the composed block that will be inserted.
